Pehla kadam dekho. Ek chakkar matlab park ka poora kinaara, ek baar: 1 chakkar = park ka parimap, kyunki rani kinaare par daudti hai, park ke beech se nahi. Yeh kadam saaf hai?

Ab doosra kadam. Park rectangle hai, toh 2 × (lambai + chaudai): P = 2 × (50 + 30), kyunki chakkar mein 50 bhi do baar aata hai aur 30 bhi.

Ab teesra kadam. Bracket ke andar jodo: 50 + 30 = 80 m, kyunki 80 m par Rani saamne wale kone par hai, aadha chakkar.

Ab agla kadam. Aadhe chakkar ko do baar lo: 2 × 80 = 160 m, kyunki do aadhe chakkar milke ek poora chakkar.

Teeno chakkar ek jaise hain, toh 160 ko 3 se guna karo: 3 chakkar = 3 × 160 m, kyunki har chakkar utna hi lamba hai, 160 m. Ab agla kadam dekhte hain.
